name: Doria Shafik
shortBio: Egyptian Sorbonne-trained philosopher (PhD on Egyptian art and Islamic aesthetics) and leader of the Bint al-Nil suffrage movement whose direct political action secured Egyptian women’s constitutional voting rights in 1956.
centralQuestion: Why does Islamic aesthetic and moral philosophy demand women’s full constitutional suffrage and civic sovereignty?

keyWorks.title: La Femme et le Droit Religieux de l’Égypte Contemporaine
keyWorks.description: Sorbonne doctoral thesis interrogating the tension between women’s philosophical dignity in Islam and discriminatory personal status law.

keyWorks.title: L'Art pour l'Art dans l'Égypte Antique
keyWorks.description: Philosophical aesthetics defending the autonomy of ancient Egyptian visual form against Eurocentric teleology.
